description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a category tab in a news app. It displays a list of news articles for a specific category, with support for pull-to-refresh and loading shimmer effects.

classes.name: CategoryTab
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of news articles for a given category, with refresh functionality and navigation to a detailed article view.

classes.name: _ShimmerList
classes.description: A private stateless widget that shows a shimmering placeholder list while content is loading.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, displaying either a shimmer placeholder or a list of news articles with pull-to-refresh.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the read article screen with the selected news article.
